due_when.clears_when: check_guard_liveness distinguishes a glob-scoped guard from a dead one, or states the limit in its own docstring

what: scripts/ci/check_guard_liveness.py classifies a guard by its module-level repo-path CONSTANTS, so a guard whose graded population is a GLOB reads dead while grading fine. MEASURED 2026-09-22: check_stated_population.py was 1 of the 8 it called dead; run against a planted diff adding docs/zz-probe.md with a bare 42.9% it exits 1 and names the line, and it is registered in run_guards.py as stated-population-guard on every PR. So 1 of 8 dead verdicts (12.5%) was a false positive, and acting on it would have deleted the only mechanical floor under CLAUDE-RULES-CANONICAL § Always state the population. The instrument states the converse limit about itself (live means its subject exists, never that it works) but not this direction. Fix: report a glob-scoped guard as its own state, or refuse to call dead any guard that is registered in run_guards.py without a run.
